div.div:
LangGraph Agent Loop
• StateGraph with 5 core nodes plus a routing decision
• Max 10 tool iterations per request
• Circuit breaker: 3 consecutive errors trigger graceful degradation
• Dynamic tool selection: up to 8 tools filtered from the query
• Context budget combines messages, memory snippets, and selective artifacts

div.div:
Tool Design Patterns
• All tools return structured dicts instead of raising exceptions
• Search tools use a 30 s timeout with keyword fallback
• Entity network traversal spans 1-3 hops with score decay
• Highlight tools emit clip timestamps for the frontend
• Dynamic selection reduces latency and token usage

div.div:
Hybrid RAG Search
• Four search layers feed a multi-signal fusion step
• Matryoshka two-stage retrieval: 512d coarse → 3072d fine
• Intent-adaptive weighting adjusts to the query type
• Temporal questions receive proximity boosting
• Entity questions receive stronger graph weighting
• Re-ranking adds expanded context and community signals

div.div:
Layered Memory Architecture
• Hot cache and artifacts feed the active prompt-time path
• Retrieval pipeline: candidate collection → reranking → budget allocation
• Selective rehydration expands only a small number of artifacts
• Context growth is bounded by per-tier limits
• Foundry Memory Store exists as an available long-term capability

div.div:
Context Injection Pattern
• Video metadata is injected as an invisible prefix on the user message
• QPrismaStateConverter parses the prefix and extracts media_id, user_id, and session_id
• The prefix is removed before the model sees the prompt
• OpenTelemetry trace context is propagated end to end
